verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say the developer runs Claude Code or Codex in an existing checkout on their own machine and runs foreloop init there. Nothing shows Foreloop or its agent cloning the repo, installing dependencies, or configuring its own environment. Installing a task-executor skill into a checkout the user already has is adjacent setup, not autonomous environment provisioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have an agent automatically clone the repo, install dependencies, and configure its own working environment
